reason: A read-only discovery and audit plugin for finding community DSH plugins on GitHub, reviewing downloaded source for selected risk patterns, and producing installation plans without installing plugins.

summaries.zh: 在 GitHub 上搜索社区 DSH 插件，下载并审查其源码与安装清单，输出风险信息和安装计划。
summaries.en: Searches GitHub for community DSH plugins, audits downloaded source and manifests for selected risks, and provides installation plans.

capabilities: Searches public GitHub repositories through the GitHub Search API
Downloads and caches repository source archives for auditing
Scans downloaded source for specified dangerous patterns
Reads and reports plugin manifests and installation commands
Writes temporary audit cache data under the workspace
